data.one_liner: Library for reading, creating, and editing Excel spreadsheet files.
data.what_it_does: Allows reading, creating, editing, and updating XLSX files and sheets on both client and server side. Supports cell styling, merging, finding and replacing text, and sheet management operations like copying and renaming.
use_when: You need to read existing Excel spreadsheets in Flutter or Dart.
You need to generate and export XLSX files dynamically from your app.
avoid_when: You are working with file formats other than XLSX (e.g., CSV or legacy XLS).
You require complex formula evaluation or PDF conversion natively (not yet documented as supported).
strengths: Supports cross-platform file reading and saving including Flutter Web.
Provides extensive cell styling capabilities (fonts, colors, alignment, borders).
Allows programmatic sheet operations like merging, finding and replacing, and insertion.
weaknesses: Formulas and PDF conversion features are listed as future updates and not yet documented.
Password protection requires an external separate package.
